source: Real, on Qwen Code 0.26.6 with an OpenRouter key through the apiKey login (OPENAI_BASE_URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash), private QWEN_HOME, driven through weft's own agent server and this spec, every line teed (scratchpad acp12/drive.py, acp12/qwen/transcript.jsonl): hello; tool, with the program's tools `lookup` and `web_fetch` (the program's `web_fetch` took the built-in's place; both discovered and called through the commands acp_qwen.py writes, neither asked); permission (`touch made.txt`, allowed, then its `craft/drainMidTurnQueue`, answered method not found). Earlier, against a local scripted OpenAI-compatible model with no account (scratchpad adw/qlive/acp.jsonl, adw/qlive2/acp_a.jsonl): the answers, the session/load replay, ask, reject and connection error (the anthropicKey way pointed at a closed port). Composed: the session/set_config_option answer ({configOptions} as its bundle returns it). available_commands_update and usage lines are left out.
